inline.s: When one sees the world as false and vain, the mind is then transformed;
One attains the Ground of Joy, and all the grounds that lead to the Buddha’s.
Once this turning has been won, one is like a mani stone of many hues;
It serves the benefit of all beings—appearing as the moon reflected in water.
Cast off the views of being and non-being, and of both and of neither,
Surpass the way of the two vehicles, and rise even above the seventh ground.
The Dharma realized within oneself is cultivated ground by ground;
Freed far from all the heterodox paths, this is called the Great Vehicle.
The gate of liberation is set forth as a hare’s horn and a mani jewel;
Abandon all discrimination, and be free from death and from passing away.
The teaching is established through the principle; the principle is made clear through the teaching;
Rely, then, on this teaching and this principle—discriminate in nothing more.”
The Lankavatara Sutra of the Great Vehicle, Volume Seven
